title: eurybia microphylla
intro: Eurybia microphylla, commonly known as Small-leaved Eurybia or Small-leaved Eurybia, is a plant species within the aster family (Asteraceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of eastern North America. The health benefits of Eurybia microphylla include its potential to lower fever, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and promote the clearance of mucus from the respiratory tract. Eurybia microphylla contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
